data.name: Physical Enhancement [Transmutation]
data.description: The implement enhances its bearer's body. When you invest mental focus in the implement, select a physical ability score. The implement grants a +2 temporary enhancement bonus to that physical ability score for every 3 points of mental focus invested in the implement (+%1), to a maximum of +%2.|OccultistPhysicalEnhancement|2*floor(1+OccultistLVL/6)
